items.text: Here's the complete list of what Patch 1.3 brings in Yerba Buena available now on all platforms (Steam, MS Store, XBOX Series X, PS5) 🧩 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021406/3d158e275f4a1072285acc33feb92156e193ba4e.jpg"]
Quality of Life & User Interface
Added a "Limit FPS" option under Graphics settings for Steam, which is available and effective when VSync is turned off.
Added a new toggle to turn Subtitles On/Off in the General Settings.
Improved the skip cutscene user experience by immediately showing the UI with a progress bar and background when pressing any button, indicating it is a "hold" action.
Fixed an issue where the new notification exclamation mark would remain stuck on Journal prompts even after they had been read.
Removed empty subtitle boxes that would occasionally appear on the screen..
Stability & Performance
Resolved multiple critical issues where players could get trapped in endless falling or death animations, including sequences in Bank Heist 2 and DestructibleIntro.
Fixed a major bug that caused the entire level to disappear if the player died on the transition platform between the Brewery and Amusement Park 1.
Fixed an issue in the Brewery where a saving animation would play without actually creating a save point.
Gameplay & Progression
Fixed bugs that prevented players from moving after certain cutscenes or caused them to get permanently stuck after puzzle resets in the Brewery and Amusement Park 2.
Fixed an issue where the very first copy interaction on a mission would not properly copy the trait.
Fixed broken laser beams at the top of the Pillars puzzle in the Bunker.
Fixed exploits that allowed players to skip early puzzles in RobotBasics or complete the BouncyArcade puzzle incorrectly after only one basket was made.
Level & World Improvements
Added missing physical barriers and colliders to various objects, such as Jorge's desk and the Glitchy Swan Ride, to prevent players from falling out of bounds or getting blocked.
Cleaned up floating objects found throughout the Bank Heist level.
Fixed flickering textures and Z-fighting at the top of the stairs in the building in front of the Convenience Store.
Camera & Visuals
Prevented the player camera from clipping through walls when getting too close.
Fixed a visual bug where the briefcase would persist on screen after navigating to the main menu and back in-game

[p align="start"]Here's the complete list of what Patch 1.2 brings in Yerba Buena 🧩
Stability & Performance
Improved overall game stability
Fixed several crashes that could occur during boss fights, puzzle completion, cutscenes, level transitions, and object interactions.
Gameplay & Progression
Fixed multiple progression blockers and softlocks throughout the game.
Resolved issues where certain puzzles, objectives, and scripted events could fail to progress correctly.
Fixed cases where players could become trapped, endlessly respawn, or be unable to continue after specific gameplay scenarios.
Improved reliability of checkpoints, save points, and respawn locations.
Level & World Improvements
Fixed numerous collision issues across environments, puzzles, and interactive objects.
Addressed multiple areas where players could leave the playable space or become stuck.
Corrected environmental issues such as floating props, misplaced geometry, clipping objects, and visual inconsistencies.
Improved puzzle interactions and object behavior throughout several levels.
Boss Fight Improvements
Fixed several issues affecting boss fight progression and phase transitions.
Resolved unintended interactions that could disrupt boss mechanics or progression.
Camera & Controls
Fixed camera clipping and visibility issues in several locations.
Fixed various controller and input-related issues.
Improved interaction prompts and tutorial guidance.
User Interface
Fixed issues causing journal entries, notifications, and dialogue elements to display incorrectly.
Resolved overlapping, cropped, and improperly formatted UI text.
Improved menu and HUD behavior across multiple resolutions and aspect ratios.
Fixed several issues related to language switching and interface updates.
Localization
Fixed missing translations and incorrectly localized text.
Improved font rendering, text formatting, and special character support.
Enhanced right-to-left language support, including text alignment and punctuation behavior.
Visual Polish
Resolved visual glitches involving textures, object attachments, and environmental effects.
Addressed various graphical artifacts, clipping issues, and visual polish items throughout the game.
